But given that Nuso Esva's the only alien in the equation, and given that everything Axlon told us about him being on our side was probably a lie, I'm guessing they're his.|A chief technician|You think he's working for the Empire?|The major|Not unless the Empire's started assassinating its own governors. A '''major''' of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was part of a team that traveled to the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]] to ally the Alliance with the [[Treason/Legends|traitorous]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. After a chief [[Technician/Legends|technician]] asked if the [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] was working with the Empire, the Rebel major growled that Esva would if the Empire was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinating]] its own governors, as Esva had [[Battle for Poln Major|attempted]] to do with Ferrouz.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The major appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
